mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, it is 66 degrees with a light drizzle near the Verona Public Library, and a Waning Gibbous moon is lighting up the night sky.
The city is performing cross connection control surveys to prevent water contamination, and residents are reminded that early in-person voting begins soon at City Hall.
There is plenty to do with Yoga at Insight Wellness, Art Bar Happy Hour, and Hop Haus Trivia all taking place today.
In a notable incident from September 21, a suspect was identified through surveillance footage and cited for stealing candy from a retail location on East Verona Avenue.
The flavor of the day is Chocolate Heath Crunch, and our local Culver's will be ready to serve you when they open today at 10:00 AM.
